about: Stages around a circle joined by arrows, each arriving as it is named, then a marker running round and round: anything that repeats and returns to its start, with a word in the middle if wanted.

stages.about: the stages in order round the circle, split by |

middle.about: words in the middle of the circle

run.about: 0 leaves out the marker that runs round once all stages are there

turn.about: seconds for the marker to go round once

when.about: moments each stage arrives; else when its name is said, or one after another
